name: Whisperwood Warden

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text:
Few forests are as foreboding and perilous as the Whisperwood. Devils dwell within, and, at its center, it's said that there's a gate to Hell itself. You've spent much of your life learning to navigate the woods' dangers and how to both protect travelers from the forest and the forest from travelers.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Dexterity or Wisdom, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Stealth skill and the Forest Lore skill. You gain the Terrain Stalker skill feat for underbrush.
